title: Paul the Apostle
summary: Paul the Apostle, known in Christian tradition as Paul of Tarsus, said he received a vision of the resurrected Jesus commissioning him as apostle to the gentiles. He made missionary journeys across Asia Minor, Greece and Rome, and reached Corinth in about the year 50. Later Christians turned to his writings when forming doctrine, and he could be viewed as the founder of Christianity as a separate religion.

uncertainty.note: WHE visual timeline places Paul's birth in Tarsus at 5 CE; missionary journeys run c. 42–62 CE; death is traditionally placed under Nero in Rome c. 64–67 CE, though historical documentation of his exact death is unconfirmed.
